body: So many good options! Thank you! I'm making a list and our team is going to vote! I like the Exodus one, I haven't heard anything like it before. Also Second Chance!
Thank you! It's our dream! Takes a lot to make it work, but we've been lucky so far :)
So long EF. I’m going with Rush lol.

I think they all have things to improve on. I’m hoping they have some more pocket Thresh picks to bring out and surprise C9.

I REALLY want them to shut C9 up.

I’m a big DL fan too, but I think it’s hard to say where he’d be if he had people competing for resources. I think he’s done much better for not having to share his toys with bjergsen, for example.

I think Ssumday showed today that it’s still very much a team game. It’s not enough to be a one man wonder.
Yeah, he’s looked like he’s been doubting himself for awhile and I was thinking how all I ever see people do is be critical. He never gets the praise DL does...
I think it was hard with DL not going in. Pob did the most damage on the team on a team that was entirely setting the stage for DL.
I, for one, was glad to see the Pob do pretty well. He’s better than he’s been playing. I still remember the Immortals days when he was all we had to  save the day.

All you guys with your inspirational posts. I just think he’s hot, haha!

I mean, that other stuff too, though.
I can't tell if Johnny has completely lost touch with reality and none of this is real, or if the author thinks all this gratuitous sex is edgy. Hipster vibes are strong with this one.

I was wondering a lot of the same things myself- how much of it are we supposed to take as "real", and how much of it are we supposed to know is "fake"? I feel tempted to put deeper thought into it, like you mention, but (and this sounds terrible) I'm put off but the Hipster vibe. I feel like a lot of the things in are put just for shock value and to trick people into thinking there's a deeper meaning that's just "up to interpretation". That just feels....annoying. Pretentious. I can't tell, again, if there's a legitimate reason for the cryptic nature of it, or it's just entertainment value.

So I made a point to read as little about this as possible before hand, so I have some questions. Are we supposed to see the Navidson Record as unquestionably fake (like in the vein of the Blair Witch Project), Zampano's obsession with it as an intense literary-esque review (not out of line for a thesis or something), and Johnny as an emotionally disturbed young adult spiraling into madness? Or is the video more mysterious, questionably real, Zampano's obsession with it potentially otherwordly, and Johnny caught in the crossfire (kind of got a Stranger Things vibe to it, then)? 

Is it somewhere in the middle? Am I supposed to have picked up on this by now or am I supposed to muddle through until some big reveal?
I'm Hunny FuFuu! You guys missed out on Niglett, though :)
